title: Final Pressure Expression
description: Essential Criteria: The final expression for pressure must be correctly derived as p = pi * hbar^2 / (4 * mu * R^5).

title: Energy Expression
description: Important Criteria: The expression for the energy in the ground state E_n = (pi^2 * hbar^2) / (2 * mu * R^2) must be correctly identified.

title: Force Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The calculation of the average force F = -dE/dR must be correctly shown.

title: Wave Function Condition
description: Important Criteria: The condition that the wave function must be finite at r = 0 should be stated and applied.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The units of pressure should be checked for consistency throughout the solution.

title: Common Sign Error
description: Pitfall Criteria: Failing to correctly apply the negative sign in the force calculation could lead to an incorrect final answer.

title: Boundary Conditions
description: Important Criteria: The boundary conditions for the wave function at r = R must be correctly applied.

title: Radial Wave Function
description: Optional Criteria: The form of the radial wave function R(r) = chi(r)/r should be correctly stated and used.
